subject: Re: Request — expanded free credits for QuantumData POC (context-heavy)
messages:
From: Eva Morales <eva@quantumdata.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expanded credits for POC — context-heavy workload

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding earlier this week. We started a small end-to-end run of our POC and hit two constraints that mean the stock trial grant is going to be exhausted in ~72 hours if we continue with realistic runs.

Quick context:
- POC workload is a document-understanding pipeline with very long documents (up to ~300k tokens per request after preprocessing).
- We expect sustained throughput peaks ~90k–120k tokens/minute during parallel batch runs (multiple workers).
- We need an additional 200k tokens/day for 30 days to complete the evaluation and compare latency/cost across model variants.

Ask: can you increase our initial free credits / trial allowance by ~180k tokens equivalent and extend the trial window by 30 days? We will use Redwood for production if the economics match our estimates.

I can share the test plan and sample logs — attaching a short spreadsheet with our expected run cadence.

Thanks,
Eva Morales
Head of ML — QuantumData
attachments: quantumdata-usage-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Eva Morales <eva@quantumdata.io>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expanded credits for POC — context-heavy workload

Hi Eva — appreciate the detail and the spreadsheet.

Two quick clarifications before I take this to ops for issuance:
1) When you say ~300k tokens per request, are you counting pre- and post-processing tokens together (input + expected returned tokens)?
2) What is the target SLA for latency in the POC (p50/p95)? that informs which model family we map for the grant.

If those match the sheet, I can request an increase and a 30‑day extension. We have a self-serve credit issuance flow for standard top-ups but anything above 150k token-equivalent for an initial grant needs manager approval. I’ve CC'd Sean and Aditya for visibility — they'll confirm budget/discount guardrails.

If you'd like, we can also do a 30-minute sync tomorrow to confirm run cadence.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Expanded credits for POC — context-heavy workload

Kimberly — skimmed the usage sheet. Short note:
- Their numbers (300k tokens/request, sustained bursts to 120k TPM) are plausible for the doc pipeline.
- Recommended initial grant: 180,000 token-equivalent credits + 30-day trial extension. This matches our standard risk tolerance when a POC shows realistic production intent.
- Put a soft condition: issue conditional on the CS monitoring plan (Monica to own health checks + cost alerts).

Monica — can you confirm no blocking security/compliance asks (SOC2 evidence already shared last quarter)? If ops can issue via self-serve link, we should do an immediate top-up to keep momentum.

Aditya — flag if you want to formalize a deal ID or invoice placeholder; else we treat as free issuance tied to QNTM-POC-2026-07.

— Sean
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Eva Morales <eva@quantumdata.io>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-14T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expanded credits for POC — context-heavy workload

Hi Eva — good news.

We approved a one-time increase to your self-serve trial allowance: 180,000 token-equivalent free credits and a 30-day extension to your current trial window. Conditions:
- Monica (cc) will enable monitoring and a cost/cap alert for the POC project.
- The grant is tied to deal id QNTM-POC-2026-07 and is non-transferable.

Next steps:
1) You should receive an automated notification from the Self-Serve Credits portal momentarily. If you do not, use this link to confirm issuance: https://app.redwood.ai/self-serve/credits/issue?acct=QNTM-POC-2026-07
2) Monica will email a short health-check template and ask you to confirm cadence (weekly).
3) If you expect to exceed the extra allowance mid-run, flag us immediately so we can discuss a paid bridge or rate-limited runs to avoid unexpected throttling.

Attaching a short grant statement for your records.

Best,
— Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
